defs.def: an order given to a person or an animal （给人或动物的）命令

ex.s: command armies of killer robotsD. work faster than a mathematician

defs.def: an instruction given to a computer 指令；命令
control and authority over a situation or a group of people 控制；管辖；指挥
a part of an army, air force, etc. that is organized and controlled separately; a group of officers who give orders （陆军、空军等的）兵团，军区，指挥部，司令部
your knowledge of sth; your ability to do or use sth, especially a language 知识；（尤指对语言的）掌握，运用能力
to tell sb to do sth 掌权者

ex.s: He was the commander of the Apollo 11 manned lunar landing mission, and was the first man to step on the lunar surface.
ex.t: 他是阿波罗11号载人登月任务的指挥官，也是第一个踏上月球表面的人。

ex.s: An order issued by Supreme Allied Commander General Eisenhower to the troops read: “Your task will not be an easy one.
ex.t: 盟军最高司令艾森豪威尔将军向部队发布的一项命令中写道： “你的任务并不容易。

ex.s: During his studies and working life, Lu developed a remarkable command of English, as well as of his native Chinese.
ex.t: 在他的学习和工作生涯中，陆培养了非凡的英语和母语汉语能力。

ex.s: All controls will respond to voice commands, so if you want to change your routine, you just say aloud what you want and the home system will obey.
ex.t: 所有控件都将响应语音命令，因此，如果您想更改例行程序，只需大声说出您想要的内容，家庭系统就会服从。

defs.def: to be in charge of a group of people in the army, navy, etc. 指挥，统率（陆军、海军等）

ex.s: When giving commands, people usually use the imperative.
ex.t: 在发布命令时，人们通常会使用命令。

defs.def: to deserve and get sth because of the special qualities you have 不用于进行时
to be in a position from where you can see or control sth 不用于进行时
to have control of sth; to have sth available for use 不用于进行时
